content: Finally upgraded my entire dev setup. New monitor, new keyboard layout, new workflow. Feels like a fresh start every time you optimize your environment.
Been diving deep into system design patterns lately. There's something satisfying about drawing architecture diagrams at 2AM with lo-fi playing in the background.
Hot take: the best code you'll ever write is the code you delete. Refactored an entire module today — removed 400 lines and it runs better.
Sometimes you just need to step away from the screen. Went for a long walk, came back, and the bug that haunted me for 3 hours was a missing semicolon.
New project brewing. Can't share details yet but it involves real-time collaboration and some really cool WebSocket stuff. Stay tuned.
Appreciation post for dark mode. Every app, every website, every IDE. If it doesn't have dark mode, I'm not using it. Non-negotiable.
Just finished a 12-hour coding session. Built an entire feature from scratch. My back hurts but my soul is happy. This is what passion feels like.
Reading 'Clean Code' for the third time. Every re-read hits different when you have more experience. Some chapters I disagreed with before now make perfect sense.
